page.layout: One page of running text, centred column, with worked arithmetic examples set in lines and small displays. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No margin notes. Signature at bottom right.

main_text.p: in medio loco fuerunt. Vera igitur est o-peratio.
Venditur Cantharus vini 4 albis. Quæritur quot albis, 2. Canthari veneant?
Nunc 48 albos duco in aureos per 26, sic:
Duodecim igitur Canthari veneunt aureo & 22 albis.
Si autem scire cupio, an recte numerave-rim, exemplum inverto hoc modo:

page.notes: The two symbol rows after "(10" are abacus-style marks; they are transcribed approximately and marked [?]. The "Quæ-" at the right of the "Venditur" line is the first part of "Quæritur", carried over in the text. The signature is read as "B 3" with the 3 uncertain. The final layout of the numerical displays (the small cross-multiplication and the division-like rules) is rendered as plain lines, so spacing is approximate.
